Method: fndiff --count then fndiff --ops on 12 of the 15 roster functions (MBNewPsysDescrip and setWorldParms excluded as too large to be diagnostic at real ~500; CritterAnimate included). subject: project:gdl
value: CORRECTION TO THE CONTROL-FLOW ROSTER: of the 15 functions that claim.regnorm-park-label-census-legacy-blanket-corpus.20260831.v1 called 'residuals ENTIRELY branch-class (if/else vs goto shape)', only a MINORITY actually are. 12 were re-measured with fndiff --ops (the opcode-multiset classifier) and they split cleanly into two populations. THE ROOT CAUSE OF THE MISLABEL: regnorm pairs instructions positionally and reports a differing branch TARGET as a CFG-BRANCH-TARGET row. When a function carries a single extra or missing instruction near its top, EVERY subsequent branch target shifts by 4 bytes, so one non-branch defect manufactures a long tail of CFG-BRANCH-TARGET rows. Eleven of the twelve functions have an instruction-count delta of exactly +/-1, which is precisely the condition that produces this artifact. The tell is mechanical and costs one command: if the regnorm rows are a UNIFORM +/-4 shift of otherwise identical branch targets, the residual is NOT branch shape -- run fndiff --ops and believe the multiset. POPULATION A, genuinely branch-shape (5 of 12), each showing a target-vs-ours disagreement about the unfused forward branch pair: CritterMoveSetup (T 'bge,b' vs O 'blt' @0xd0), fn_8004DB3C (T 'bne,b' vs O 'beq' @0x3c), PlaceItem (T 'bne,b' vs O 'beq' @0x6c), ControllerMessageBox (T 'bne,b' vs O 'beq' @0x308), CritterAnimate (T 'blt,b' vs O 'bge' @0x60, plus an unrelated 'li' cluster). WorldDynCollide is the MIRROR case and belongs here too: at 0x1e8 and 0x200 OURS emits the pair 'beq;b' and the TARGET emits the fused single 'bne ->0x238' straight to the epilogue -- so the roster contains the mechanism in BOTH directions, which is itself evidence that it is front-end block layout rather than a source idiom one side simply forgot. The spelling lever for this population is recorded separately as claim.law.ternary-diamond-reaches-forward-branch-pair-at-cost-of-temp-result-register.20260831.v1. POPULATION B, not control flow at all (7 of 12) -- and they are all ONE mechanism, an extra address/pointer register COPY that the target avoids by writing a computed value straight into its final register: LoadItems (ours-only '-1 addi'; ours completes sObjectsFile's HA+LO into r3 then copies 'addi r30,r3,0', target reuses r3 and writes the LO directly as 'addi r30,r3,LO'), StartWorldLoad (byte-for-byte the same signature as LoadItems, same two-pointer-locals source shape -- solve once, apply twice), LoadWorldData, LoadWorldDone, init_player_change (extra 'addi r28,r4,0' copy @0x30), pbDrawVerts (extra 'addi r7,r8,0' copy @0x94), and ProcessCritterList (mtctr/addi/li reordering, i.e. counted-loop induction form, not branch shape). HIGH-VALUE HAND-OFF TO THE ADDR16 FORENSICS LANE: two of Population B are additional instances of the exact mechanism work_claim.addr16lo-forensics.20260831.v1 is researching and that claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1 declares source-unreachable across ~10 axes. LoadWorldDone emits 'addi r0,r3,0 @lbl_8028C9A8(ADDR16_LO)' then 'mr r28,r0' where the target writes 'addi r28,r3,0 @LO' directly; LoadWorldData emits 'addi r0,r3,0 @lbl_80257680(ADDR16_LO)' then 'mr r31,r0' where the target writes 'addi r27,r3,0 @LO'. These are instances four and five, they live in world.c and gauntworld.c (TUs that lane is not working), and they should be screened as BLOCKED rather than probed by any control-flow lane. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION that the blanket label was wrong: dynobjgrid.c's own file header comment already documented WorldDynCollide's residual as 'target keeps an extra addi r6,r3,0 copy web for d + nonvolatile color rotation (r28..r31); opcode stream otherwise exact' -- a correct in-tree diagnosis that the legacy import overwrote with 'REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE' and that the regnorm census then re-labelled as branch-class. Reading the TU header comment is free and was skipped by both passes. STANDING RULE EARNED: regnorm's row CLASSES are positional artifacts whenever instruction counts differ; use regnorm to locate, use fndiff --ops to classify, and never re-type a park from row classes alone while an instruction-count delta is outstanding.
